subject: Junior Project Manager application, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello Central Vic Civil team,

I'm applying for the Junior Project Manager role in Ballarat that I saw on SEEK.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, plus cost estimates and bills of quantities. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site there as a field engineer and project-in-charge, coordinating 10 to 15 workers a day, tracking procurement and materials and writing progress reports.

Your advert asks for a recent civil graduate who can help with programming, cost tracking, documentation and subcontractor coordination on water, roadworks and land development jobs, which is the work I want to grow into. I'm based in Melton VIC with a licence, my own transport and a White Card, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I don't have Australian civil construction experience yet, so I would start at junior level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
